title: Design System: Course Digital Twin Professor Console

headline.purpose: Page title and active dossier heading.

title.purpose: Decision groups, review artifacts, and route labels.

body.purpose: Prompts, policy values, explanations, and evidence.

label.purpose: Short uppercase indices, references, and state captions.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Selection, hover, focus, and disclosure feedback.

components.name: Primary Decision Button
components.description: The decisive action within the current review region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#101828; color:#fff; border:1px solid #101828; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 14px; font:600 14px/1.4 'Geist Variable',system-ui,sans-serif; transition:background 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#1d2939; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:#0c111d; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A reversible or supporting review action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:#fff; color:#101828; border:1px solid #d9e0ea; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 14px; font:600 14px/1.4 'Geist Variable',system-ui,sans-serif; transition:border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1),background 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#f5f7fb; border-color:#98a2b3; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background:#eef4ff; }

components.name: Review Field
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; color:#344054; font:650 11px/1.35 'Geist Variable',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-field input { min-width:260px; background:#fff; color:#101828; border:1px solid #d9e0ea; border-radius:6px; padding:9px 11px; font:400 14px/1.5 'Geist Variable',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:0; text-transform:none; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:#98a2b3; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color:#1d4ed8; outline:2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Active Release Stage
components.description: The selected step in the professor-controlled release route.
components.css: .ds-stage { width:260px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:28px 1fr; gap:10px; align-items:start; text-align:left; background:#eef4ff; color:#1d4ed8; border:1px solid #b9cdfb; border-radius:4px; padding:10px 12px; font-family:'Geist Variable',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-stage:hover { background:#e0eaff; } .ds-stage:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-stage-index { font-size:11px; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:.1em; } .ds-stage strong { display:block; color:#101828; font-size:14px; line-height:1.35; } .ds-stage small { display:block; margin-top:2px; color:#475467; font-size:12px; line-height:1.4; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A compact state label whose wording remains understandable without color.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:#fff7e6; color:#754106; border:1px solid #f5c875; border-radius:4px; padding:3px 7px; font:650 11px/1.35 'Geist Variable',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-status span { width:6px; height:6px; background:#a15c08; border-radius:50%; }

narrative.overview: The professor console combines an academic review dossier with the decisiveness of a code-review merge gate. It is precise, calm, and accountable: every action is visibly connected to evidence, policy, or release impact. The screen should feel like one continuous working document, not a collection of dashboard cards. The interface uses compact editorial hierarchy, ruled divisions, numbered decision references, and restrained status color. It refuses generic AI-chat styling, opaque automation, decorative SaaS polish, and invented intelligence.
keyCharacteristics: A persistent five-stage release route with one selected work surface.
Evidence and workflow trace remain adjacent to the current decision.
Flat paper surfaces separated by rules, spacing, and tonal bands.
Cobalt marks interaction; amber, red, and green communicate status only.
All state is expressed in text as well as color.

rules.name: The Status Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red never decorate; each use must explain a real review state in accompanying text.

rules.name: The One Active Signal Rule
rules.body: Cobalt identifies the current route or action, not every interactive surface at once.

rules.name: The Working Scale Rule
rules.body: No product heading exceeds 24px; the console is a review instrument, not a landing page.

rules.name: The Ruled Paper Rule
rules.body: Prefer a divider or a slight background change over a new floating card.

dos: Do lead with the current release state and next professor decision.
Do place supporting evidence beside the action it justifies.
Do preserve the exact five stages: Sources, Interview, Policy, Preview, and Approval.
Do use whitespace and ruled sections before adding another container.
Do keep professor authority explicit for revisions and approval.
donts: Don't make chat the visual identity of the product.
Don't duplicate route navigation with a second tab bar.
Don't add invented analytics, course data, people, integrations, or release actions.
Don't use gradients, glass, purple AI branding, oversized heroes, or soft decorative shadows.
Don't hide blockers, provenance, or uncertainty behind color-only state.
